subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_________ of the shops in the High Street have closed recently.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word **'Most'** fits correctly,** indicating a large number of shops in the High Street that have closed recently.**

 
 
• She plays tennis** most **mornings.​
 
• **Most** of the information was useful. Some of it wasn't relevant
 
 

Hence, the correct word for fill in the blanks is **'most.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word** 'Quite' **would be **grammatically incorrect** in this context, as it doesn't fit the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **'Little'** is inappropriate because it refers to **a small quantity, which does not convey the correct meaning for the given context.**
 
• **'Very**' **cannot be used **on its own in this sentence; it needs to modify an adjective or another adverb.
